sample_output.question: Where should we list a paid metered research MCP first?
sample_output.tldr: List where callers already browse for distribution first. Smithery external listing is described as free in third-party writeups; the official MCP registry exists (Anthropic AAIF post). Take rate for both is unknown — do not invent a % comparison.

option_scope.Smithery listing: Third-party MCP directory / hosted surface (Arcade-era context).
option_scope.Official MCP registry: Official registry called out in Anthropic AAIF materials.

table.Smithery listing: External listing described as free in third-party plan writeups; confirm on smithery.ai.
table.Official MCP registry: Listing cost not independently confirmed in this run.
table.winner_if: If zero listing cost matters and Smithery free listing holds → Smithery for discovery.

table.Smithery listing: Not verified as a first-party checkout/meter for arbitrary paid MCPs.
table.Official MCP registry: Directory, not a payment rail — do not assume built-in metering.
table.winner_if: Meter via your own Stripe API key; treat registries as discovery only.

table.Smithery listing: Known browsing surface for MCP servers (qualitative).
table.Official MCP registry: Canonical discovery path referenced by Anthropic/AAIF materials.
table.winner_if: If you care about official-ecosystem reach → official registry; list both if cheap.
Cannot rank on take rate without first-party marketplace terms.

recommendation.overall: Prioritize distribution (list where callers browse). Refuse a fake take-rate comparison until first-party terms are fetched.
conditional: If discovery on Smithery is free → list there for reach.
If official registry listing is available → list there for canonical reach.
Bill humans via Stripe API keys; do not depend on registry take rate for revenue.
